name: @smthrs/bug-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker that receives smithers bug reports and demo requests and stores them in KV

scripts.plan: alchemy deploy --dry-run --stage "${ALCHEMY_STAGE:?set ALCHEMY_STAGE to the stage to plan}"
scripts.destroy: alchemy destroy --stage "${ALCHEMY_STAGE:?set ALCHEMY_STAGE to the stage to destroy}"
